findings.subject: incorrect-step-14
findings.claim: Step 14 is incorrect. The CSS appended in this step sets body opacity to 0 and depends on the .loaded class being added by JavaScript, but the script.js file is never referenced in any HTML page, so the website content will be permanently invisible.
findings.rationale: The step appends 'body { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }' and '.loaded { opacity: 1; }'. The script.js applies .loaded via window load event listener. However, none of the HTML files (index.html, publications.html, blog.html) contain a <script> tag referencing js/script.js, so the .loaded class is never applied and the body stays at opacity:0.
findings.recommended_action: Either add '<script src="js/script.js"></script>' before </body> in all HTML pages, or remove the body opacity:0 rule from the CSS.
